text: Within the N=256 arm, the half-final step tracks final margin: seed 57 has margin 0.118 and half-final step 75, while the other seeds have 0.168-0.187 and steps 85-100. Would a threshold on the headroom-normalized margin, (R2 - control)/(1 - control), remove the plateau-height confound from both the half-final and the 0.1-bar measures?
